notes.title: 2025 Plans
notes.content:
Hi Everyone,

I'd like to announce a preview of things to come to [b]Legend of Crystal Valley[/b]:

For the past 2 years we've been slowly working on porting our old engine to modern platforms.
In the process of doing so, we released one of the games we made using the same engine that has been used for the Legend of Crystal Valley. The game is a platformer game for kids, called [b]"Tibor: Tale of a Kind Vampire"[/b], which was originally released in 2009.
Check it out [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3285420/Tibor_Tale_of_a_Kind_Vampire/][b]here[/b][/url].

These games were made using 'Python' and 'Ogre3D engine' and now the old games run inside our newer engine which we use for most of our other games. Think of it as a sort of a 'virtual machine' for older games.

What this means in short term is that we are planning to port the Legend of Crystal Valley to this new engine. This will immediately bring the following benefits:
[list]
[*]The game's 3D models will look much sharper and will be anti-aliased, (no more hard edges)
[*]The game will work on MacOS and Linux
[/list]

This is just the beginning, the first step in a larger journey of remastering Legend of Crystal Valley. We have more plans to improve this game in 2025, stay tuned. 🙂

All of these upgrades, like the previous ones - are coming to you as a free update, no DLC and no "Deluxe" or "Remastered" Edition.

notes.title: German version now available
notes.content:
We have added German language version of the game.
The German version features:
- fully localized game
- complete German voice-acting for all characters
